name: PORTRAIT3D-the-wolf-a-man

name: PORTRAIT3D-a-texture-a-talk

name: PORTRAIT3D-faces-without-data

name: PORTRAIT3D-the-child-a-man

name: PORTRAIT3D-the-dial-head-jagged
note: The dial's head scaled down in square pixels.

name: PORTRAIT3D-any-curse-stands
